_comment: Checked-in Gemini price table. Milestone 6 replaced the placeholder prices
that build.md carried with figures that had never been verified.
verified_on/source record when these numbers were read and from where.
Re-verify before trusting a cost estimate, and bump verified_on when you do.
All figures are USD per 1M tokens, Standard tier, Paid tier. 'output' is
Google's 'Output price (including thinking tokens)', so thinking tokens are
billed at the output rate and MUST NOT be added on top of it again.
gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-3.7-flash are deliberately absent: neither has
a section on the pricing page as of verified_on. Do not add them from a
third-party aggregator; if a model is missing here, the cost estimate is

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: Current default. Free tier is free of charge but content is used to improve Google products.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.note: Cheapest listed. M2-era model; check for a shutdown date before adopting it.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: Introductory pricing doubles on 2027-01-01; the *_from_2027_01_01 fields are recorded so a budget that crosses that date is not wrong by 2x.
